terms.comment: The libellī use it for the tablecloth.
Later also a tablecloth, a post-classical sense, which Traupman gives.

towels.html: The libellī use linteum for the tablecloth (Mart. XIV 138). Traupman (p. 125) gives mantēle, which is a tablecloth only in a post-classical sense (Lewis & Short: Isidore, Orig. 19.26.6; Trebellius Pollio).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 125, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.
